name: censosenso-mcp-worker
description: Cloudflare Worker do CensoSenso MCP para transporte Streamable HTTP, com preflight reproduzivel antes do deploy.

scripts.prepare:parent: npm --prefix .. ci && npm --prefix .. run typecheck && npm --prefix .. run build
scripts.predeploy: npm run prepare:parent && npm run typecheck && npm test

//: @modelcontextprotocol/server and zod are intentionally NOT listed here — they resolve from the parent package's node_modules so there is a single SDK copy (avoids duplicate-instance type clashes with registerAll). `agents` declares them as hard peers, so .npmrc pins legacy-peer-deps=true to stop npm from installing a second copy here. If you extract this Worker to its own repo, add them as dependencies and depend on the corresponding published CensoSenso package when one exists.
